reason: This is not a narrow local fix: it refactors chunk reuse/allocation across multiple core executor paths (join, window, distsql, builder) and also changes session/sysvar plumbing. Even without planner-semantic changes, allocator/lifetime refactors in executor are high-blast-radius runtime-correctness work and can hide severe issues like row data corruption, stale chunk reuse, incorrect result propagation, panics, or session-level misconfiguration effects. The scope and centrality are enough to justify a focused deep review for Blocker/High bugs.
